title: Mahalia Jackson's style, comparisons, her death and her Dorsey album
summary: The companion compares Mahalia's and Bessie Griffin's styles, and those of Joe May and Cleophus Robinson. Dorsey praises Mahalia's reach, describes his grief at her death, and the companion mentions her album of his songs.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: She was one of those. Yeah. Did you see anything in similarity between Mahalia style and Bessie Griffin style at the time?

Well, for so, I didn't pay any attention. When one had the floor, I was on that floor, I was giving them all the credit. What we're trying to get at is, was there anything about these New Orleans singers that really made them different?

Bessie and Mahalia style was similar. Uh-huh. In fact, they were a take off of Bessie Smith. Uh-huh. Yeah. Both styles, Mahalia and Bessie, they were almost identical. And then, but there was a man also, two men, who also had that same style that did not come from New Orleans, you see. There was Brother Joe May, and Cleophus Robinson. Uh-huh. All their styles are all similar. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. It's all similar, you see. But it was Mahalia who made it famous. Well, Mahalia covered the whole world.

Mahalia not only, she worked in everything, just the church, the lodge, wherever they wanted her to sing, and she sang her gospel songs, she was easy to get. And she loved to do it. Now the boy you just mentioned there, he's good, but he didn't get around as much as Mahalia.
You mean Joe May or Cleopas?

Yeah. Yeah. They were like Mahalia. In fact, they couldn't. Yeah. Mahalia had a style that they couldn't even emulate. So, one thing that hurt me most, other than anything in life, except my mom can't believe God, when I heard that Mahalia's dead, I didn't know what to do. I didn't know what to do. I wouldn't go home, wouldn't go to die, I think. I went to a funeral. You did it, yeah. I didn't want to see it. Well, she does not another Mahalia Jackson.
You may never. Well, you know, she recorded a whole album of just your songs.
Yeah, just her songs, Dorsey's songs. Yeah. That was a tribute to him. And the great friendships that she had for her.
